#('MAContainer' 'MAPriorityContainer' 'MAStringDescription' 'MASymbolDescription' 'MAMemoDescription' 'MAPasswordDescription' 'MANumberDescription' 'MABooleanDescription' 'MATokenDescription' 'MAToOneRelationDescription' 'MAToManyRelationDescription' 'MAToManyScalarRelationDescription' 'MASingleOptionDescription' 'MAMultipleOptionDescription') do: [ :className | | target root prefix selectors fields graph reads props metaValidation flattened memento edits stagedReads editValidation finalReads initialSlots |
 descs := Dictionary new. ids := IdentityDictionary new. objects := Dictionary new. objectIds := IdentityDictionary new.
 encode := [ :v | | type entries |
 (objectIds includesKey: v) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'reference'. 'value' -> (objectIds at: v) } ] ifFalse: [
 v isNil ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'nil' } ] ifFalse: [
 (v isKindOf: Boolean) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'boolean'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [

 entries := v collect: [ :e | encode value: e ]. Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> type. 'value' -> entries asArray } ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
exportPredicate := [ :p | | n |
 n := Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> p class name asString }.
 p class = MAPluggableCondition ifTrue: [
 n at: 'selector' put: (p instVarNamed: 'selector') asString; at: 'index' put: (p instVarNamed: 'index'); at: 'receiver' put: (encode value: (p instVarNamed: 'receiver')); at: 'arguments' put: ((p instVarNamed: 'arguments') collect: [ :v | encode value: v ]) asArray ] ifFalse: [
 n at: 'conditions' put: ((p class = MANegationCondition ifTrue: [ { p instVarNamed: 'condition' } ] ifFalse: [ p instVarNamed: 'conditions' ]) collect: [ :c | exportPredicate value: c ]) asArray ]. n ].

 a class = MAChainAccessor ifTrue: [
 steps := OrderedCollection new. next := a.
 [ next class = MAChainAccessor ] whileTrue: [ steps add: (exportAccessor value: next accessor). next := next next ].
 steps add: (exportAccessor value: next). n at: 'steps' put: steps asArray ] ifFalse: [

exportNode := [ :id :d | | n props labels |
 props := Dictionary new.
 d properties keysAndValuesDo: [ :k :v |
 (#(conditions labels) includes: k) ifFalse: [
 k = #displayBlockOrSymbol ifTrue: [ v = #greaseString ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported display override' ] ] ifFalse: [ props at: k asString put: (encode value: v) ] ] ].

 'conditions' -> (d conditions collect: [ :assoc | Dictionary newFrom: { 'label' -> assoc value. 'predicate' -> (exportPredicate value: assoc key) } ]) asArray }.

 n at: 'labels' put: labels asArray ]. n ].

 className = 'MANumberDescription' ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionMin descriptionMax) ].
 className = 'MABooleanDescription' ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionTrueString descriptionFalseString) ].
 className = 'MAMemoDescription' ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionLineCount ].
 className = 'MATokenDescription' ifTrue: [ selectors add: #descriptionSeparators ].
 (target isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionSorted descriptionExtensible) ].
 (target isKindOf: MAToManyRelationDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionOrdered descriptionDefinitive descriptionSorted) ].
 (target isKindOf: MAMultipleOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ selectors addAll: #(descriptionDistinct descriptionOrdered) ].
 fields := OrderedCollection new.
 selectors do: [ :selector | | field id ref refId |
 field := target perform: selector.
 field ifNotNil: [
 id := prefix , '.' , field accessor readSelector asString.
 fields add: field. root add: field. descs at: id put: field. ids at: field put: id.
 (field isKindOf: MAReferenceDescription) ifTrue: [
 ref := field reference. ref accessor: (MANullAccessor uuid: nil).
 refId := id , '.reference'. descs at: refId put: ref. ids at: ref put: refId ] ] ].
 reads := fields collect: [ :field | Dictionary newFrom: { 'field' -> (ids at: field). 'value' -> (encode value: (target readUsing: field)) } ].
 flattened := [ :e | (e isKindOf: MAMultipleErrors) ifTrue: [ e collection flatCollect: [ :c | flattened value: c ] ] ifFalse: [ { Dictionary newFrom: { 'code' -> e class name asString. 'description' -> (ids at: e tag ifAbsent: [ 'target' ]) } } ] ].
 metaValidation := [ root validate: target. #() ] on: MAValidationError do: [ :e | (flattened value: e) asArray ].
 props := Dictionary new.
 target properties keysAndValuesDo: [ :key :value | key = #displayBlockOrSymbol ifFalse: [ props at: key asString put: (encode value: value) ] ].
 graph := Dictionary newFrom: { 'format' -> 'magritte.graph/3'. 'root' -> prefix. 'descriptions' -> (descs keys sorted collect: [ :id | exportNode value: id value: (descs at: id) ]) asArray. 'objects' -> #() }.

 initialSlots := className = 'MATokenDescription' ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'separators' -> (encode value: target separators) } ] ifFalse: [ Dictionary new ].
 memento := MACheckedMemento model: target description: root.
 edits := OrderedCollection with: ('label' -> 'Edited') with: ('priority' -> 23) with: ('type' -> 'Ignored').
 className = 'MANumberDescription' ifTrue: [ edits addAll: { 'min' -> 7. 'max' -> 12. 'default' -> 8 } ].
 className = 'MABooleanDescription' ifTrue: [ edits addAll: { 'trueString' -> 'YES!'. 'falseString' -> 'NO!' } ].
 className = 'MAMemoDescription' ifTrue: [ edits add: 'lineCount' -> 6 ].
 className = 'MATokenDescription' ifTrue: [ edits add: 'separators' -> '|;' ].
 (target isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ edits addAll: { 'sorted' -> true. 'extensible' -> true } ].
 (target isKindOf: MAToManyRelationDescription) ifTrue: [ edits addAll: { 'ordered' -> true. 'definitive' -> true. 'sorted' -> true } ].
 (target isKindOf: MAMultipleOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ edits addAll: { 'distinct' -> true. 'ordered' -> true } ].
 edits do: [ :edit | memento write: edit value using: (descs at: prefix , '.' , edit key) ].
 stagedReads := fields collect: [ :field | Dictionary newFrom: { 'field' -> (ids at: field). 'value' -> (encode value: (memento readUsing: field)) } ].
 editValidation := [ memento validate. #() ] on: MAValidationError do: [ :e | (flattened value: e) asArray ].
 self assert: target label = 'Custom'.
 memento commit.
 finalReads := fields collect: [ :field | Dictionary newFrom: { 'field' -> (ids at: field). 'value' -> (encode value: (target readUsing: field)) } ].
 records add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> className. 'key' -> 'Value'. 'slots' -> initialSlots. 'type' -> target type. 'properties' -> props. 'graph' -> graph. 'reads' -> reads asArray. 'validation' -> metaValidation. 'edits' -> (edits collect: [ :a | Dictionary newFrom: { 'field' -> (prefix , '.' , a key). 'value' -> (encode value: a value) } ]) asArray. 'stagedReads' -> stagedReads asArray. 'editValidation' -> editValidation. 'finalReads' -> finalReads asArray. 'sampleValidation' -> (className = 'MANumberDescription' ifTrue: [ [ target validate: 5. #() ] on: MAValidationError do: [ :e | ((flattened value: e) collect: [ :leaf | leaf at: 'code' ]) asArray ] ] ifFalse: [ #() ]) }) ].
 records asArray
] ] ensure: [ (base , 'self-description-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"kind":"pure-magritte-reference","nativeResources":false}' ] ].
